resources.string: Reduces audio sampling rate and disables non-essential UI animations during playback to save battery overnight.
Balances the output master volume across all concurrently active tracks, ensuring consistent loudness without clipping.
Slowly ramps the volume back up over 5 minutes when the sleep timer expires, smoothly transitions you to wakefulness.
Gently waking you up with soft ambient sounds
Tap to mute, Hold to fade out
Craft your personal bedtime soundscape to fall asleep faster and sleep deeper throughout the night.
Enjoy Power Save Mode to save battery overnight, and Loudness Normalization to prevent audio clipping.
Wake up naturally to a climbing volume ramp and a simulated sunrise illumination screen.
